text: Load a machine definition from a JSON file
Definition supports a list of states
Definition supports transitions with events (from, to, event)
Transitions support optional guard conditions evaluated against a context
Validation detects transitions referencing unknown states
Validation detects missing initial state (absent or not among states)
Validation errors reported clearly with non-zero exit
Run a sequence of events against the machine
Events without a valid transition (or failing guard) are handled/reported, not silently accepted
Malformed JSON / missing file handled gracefully (no traceback)
Guard evaluation is safe (no arbitrary code execution via definition)
